نتبلور (form IIq)
# نَتَبَلْوَرُ (natabalwaru) /na.ta.bal.wa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَلْوَرَ (tabalwara)
# نَتَبَلْوَرَ (natabalwara) /na.ta.bal.wa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَلْوَرَ (tabalwara)
# نَتَبَلْوَرْ (natabalwar) /na.ta.bal.war/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَلْوَرَ (tabalwara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
